description: Use after data_flow_record_check for a compliance review of each personal data flow: legal basis, special category and children's data, consent and legitimate interest records, retention, international transfer tools and transfer impact assessments, and DPIA need, with an action, GDPR article and 30/60/90-day roadmap. Requires ClevSec Pro.

destination.description: Recipients or systems the data goes to

name.description: Name of the processing activity, e.g. 'Newsletter'

retention.description: How long the data is kept, or the criteria

transferCountry.description: Country outside the EEA the data goes to, or N/A

enum: Adequacy decision (incl. EU-US Data Privacy Framework)

name: data_flow_review
title: GDPR data flow compliance review (ClevSec Pro)
